question: In a certain code language, 'FIT' is written as 'FGIST' and 'KIN' is written as 'KLIMN'. How will 'JOY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'FIT' is written as 'FGIST',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1cc1fc89912c777248cda0e6dc53d9f5c8a7552c268ff7b1e539c10140bcb27.png] 

‘KIN' is written as 'KLIMN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/876c7d7e177dbfb631c6a8ceedfddcea8dc94058b79841163dbfb9691e5c83a8.png] 

Similarly, for 'JOY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46075b386a81a6b5b4fad7228fb27a5b8947d29f665f9450712402e2139efe05.png] 

So, 'JOY' will be written as 'JKOXY'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
